## S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher as Consumer Spending Slows but Inflation Persists

A spending-slow/inflation-sticky backdrop pressures growth multiples and raises the probability of rates staying higher for longer — a direct headwind for high-multiple tech names across the portfolio.

- S&P 500 futures are modestly higher despite a mixed macro backdrop.
- Slowing consumer spending alongside persistent inflation points to a stagflationary tilt in the data.
- The combination complicates the Fed's reaction function and near-term rate-path clarity.
